feature: One hidden mark shows itself (Hugh, 2026-10-27): on a narrow card row, a tier that would fold exactly one mark draws that mark rather than a +1, and a +N always counts two or more
note: Run on a scratch branch of local-dev, migrated to main, whose audit account holds the same deck ids as staging. At 1300 the same rows sit in the wide tier and fold nothing, the before-and-after-identical control. Measured on the same branch at 320 and 390: every row 34px, the fixed right-hand columns at one x on every row, and no overflow from the name block.
